For back-office processing related inquiries, the firm can be reached at the following: Bunge Chicago, LLC Back Office Operations 111 West Jackson Blvd Suite 1700 Chicago, IL 60604 Via Email: Marian.Gibson@bunge.com derivatives.compliance@bunge.com Piotr.Zubin@bunge.com Jennifer.Esquivel@bunge.com Via Phone: 312-347-1100 To view our list of MIAX Futures Clearing Members, please see our website here . For more information, please contact MIAX Futures Clearing Operations at MIAXFuturesClearingOperations@miaxglobal.com or (612) 321-7146. To learn more about MIAX Futures, please contact MIAXFutures@miaxglobal.com . To register or revise MIAX Futures Alert subscriptions, visit MIAX Email Subscriptions .

title: MIAX Pearl Equities - Market Wide Circuit Breaker Testing and Member Designation Standards
raw_text:
MIAX Pearl Equities — Regulatory Alert, Trading Alert — MIAX Pearl Equities - Market Wide Circuit Breaker Testing and Member Designation Standards
Regulatory Alert, Trading Alert MIAX Pearl Equities September 01, 2026 | 12:36 PM MIAX Pearl Equities - Market Wide Circuit Breaker Testing and Member Designation Standards MIAX Pearl Equities, in coordination with other market centers and the Securities Information Processors (“SIPs”), will participate in the 2026 annual Market Wide Circuit Breaker (“MWCB”) test. In accordance with MIAX Pearl Rule 2622, Limit Up-Limit Down Plan and Trading Halts, certain MIAX Pearl Equities Members have mandatory participation requirements in the annual MWCB test. Please refer to MIAX Pearl Equities Regulatory Circular 2026-09 for more information. For questions regarding the MWCB test, please contact Trading Operations at TradingOperations@miaxglobal.com or (609) 897-7302. Regulatory inquiries should be directed to Regulatory@miaxglobal.com or (609) 897-7309.
